name: The Temple of the Moon
summary: In Darnassus, Sister Aquinne calls for aid to a suffering ancient creature in Teldrassil. The Sisterhood of Elune needs help, and this is the opening call to a solemn ritual of mercy.

sections.title: A Plea in the Gardens
sections.body: Sister Aquinne asks for help in the Temple Gardens. As a devoted servant of Elune, she speaks for her order: a venerable forest creature is suffering, and the Sisters cannot attend to it alone.

sections.title: Into the Moon Temple
sections.body: Sister Aquinne sends you southeast to the Temple of the Moon. Priestess A'moora coordinates the rituals and practical duties needed to address Teldrassil's troubled wildlife, preparing allies to carry out a sorrowful act of mercy.

faq.q: Who starts the quest The Temple of the Moon?
aliases: quest giver temple of the moon
where to get temple of the moon quest
who gives the temple of the moon
faq.answer: Sister Aquinne begins the call for help. She stands outside in Darnassus's Temple Gardens district.
Priestess A'moora is inside the Temple of the Moon, just southeast of the Temple Gardens in Darnassus.

faq.q: What is the creature in need of help?
aliases: what is this quest chain about
faq.answer: The creature is Sathrah, a revered spider of Teldrassil. Her plight leads to a ritual of mercy overseen by the priesthood.

faq.q: Is this quest mandatory to continue the chain?
aliases: is temple of the moon required
can i skip temple of the moon
faq.answer: No. The Temple of the Moon is an optional breadcrumb. You can speak directly with Priestess A'moora inside the temple to take up the ritual tasks without first visiting Sister Aquinne.

faq.q: What quest follows after this one?
aliases: next quest after temple of the moon
temple of the moon follow up
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora offers Tears of the Moon. She asks you to end Lady Sathrah's suffering and bring back her silvery spinnerets.

faq.q: Why is the Sisterhood of Elune asking outsiders for help?
aliases: why does the priesthood need help
faq.answer: Corruption lingers in Teldrassil's flora and fauna, stretching the Sisterhood thin. The priestesses seek capable travelers who respect nature and the Goddess.

angles.text: As a night elf, answering Sister Aquinne helps protect Teldrassil's sacred ecosystem and uphold the guidance of Elune's priesthood.
As a priest, you may feel drawn to the Sisterhood's work in Darnassus, helping fellow servants of the divine with rites of healing and mercy.
As a druid, you care deeply when a great creature of the wild is in distress. The call from the Temple Gardens asks you to help restore natural harmony.
